handoff_tasks.resolution: Preserve DateTime Kind; encode local values as UTC ticks and restore them through the receiving local zone, following measured Microsoft XNA over FNA. Use the existing Sharp Runtime TimeZone component privately.

The committed oracle/runner reproduces all three fixture files byte-for-byte and records actual loaded assembly hashes.

Four native regression groups fail before correction. All seven focused cases pass after it in each of UTC+2, UTC and New York; the complete 313-case selected XNB native suite passes privately with dummy audio.
Eight provenance/pipeline metadata gates pass with the new artifacts staged. All docs local links and fences pass; the broken command/duplicated tail in the interoperability guide is corrected.

No new Sharp Runtime implementation, stub or public C ABI change. Conversion retains Sharp Runtime timezone limits; the measurement does not qualify ambiguous DST identity or native Windows execution.

`SOFTWARE` is a bounded CPU renderer, and `HEADLESS` and `STUB` make no pixel claim (`docs/renderer-registry.md`, "Categories and maturity")..
Per-subsystem capability boundaries, by design rather than defect, are in the documents listed in §3..
In a `CNA_SHARED_LIBRARY=ON` tree, `CMAKE_LINK_DEPENDS_NO_SHARED` (`CMakeLists.txt`) keeps the executables from relinking when `libcna.so` changes.
**Pixel-centre bias.** Every renderer moves 3D triangles 63/128 of a pixel, not 1/2, to emulate Direct3D 9's integer pixel centres (2026-10-26 audit B2-07).
**Pixel centres of lines and points.** The XNA correction above moves triangles only, in every FNA3D driver; lines and points are drawn at the host's half-integer centres.
**MojoShader SPIR-V gaps** (FNA3D's SDLGPU driver, CNA's SDLGPU and WEBGPU compiled effects): ps_1_4 `BEM` and `TEXDEPTH` refuse by name ("unimplemented in spirv profile"); GLSL implements both..

**MojoShader FOG and other vertex semantics** (after the review's fixes): FOG in any lane, alone or packed, translates in every profile, and SPIR-V's vertex and pixel FOG interfaces match in type; GLSL ES and Metal place FOG lanes positionally, so a vertex/pixel pair declaring FOG in different lanes behaves differently there than in the other profiles (not measured on Direct3D 9).

**FNA3D OpenGL ES 3 readback** reads RGBA8, `ColorSrgbEXT` (stored as `GL_SRGB8_ALPHA8` since the review; the unsized format FNA3D used before was refused by ES 3 at upload, so such a texture never had storage), the float formats, and any other format only where the implementation's own read layout is the format's; it refuses the rest by name.

**FNA3D pixel-store state**: readbacks and uploads save and restore every pack/unpack value they set, so another user of the context keeps its own; an upload therefore makes six `glGetIntegerv` calls, each a synchronization point under Mesa's glthread..

**FNA3D tracing with several devices** shares one trace session among overlapping devices without telling them apart: the second device's creation is not recorded and its calls replay on the first device's state (2026-10-26 review R9-02), and its SwapBuffers with its own window override still trips the tracer's assertion.

**MojoShader's D3D11 glue** (FNA3D's D3D11 driver; found in the review's third round, not fixed): a ps_3_0 register packing semantics that the vertex shader writes to separate registers (FOG in `o1.x`, TEXCOORD0 in `o2.yzw`, read together from `v0`) produces HLSL naming a member that does not exist and fails to compile -- also before the review (R9-01); and the integer input-layout rewrite finds a semantic by substring, so `DEPTH1` can match an earlier `DEPTH10` and swap their integer/float declarations (R9-03).

**SDL_shadercross initialization is the application's** (MojoShader's SDL_GPU glue): the glue calls neither `SDL_ShaderCross_Init()` nor `_Quit()`, which act on the whole process without reference counting, so DXBC is offered only after the application initialized ShaderCross (`mojoshader.h`); FNA3D's SDLGPU driver forwards DXBC to SDL when it is offered.
**A shared SDL prebuilt can change under a running build** when a tree with another manifest rebuilds it (2026-10-26 review R3-01/R4-01; the watched stamp protects only the next build).

**Audio output has no device-change or device-loss handling of CNA's own.** The SDL3 backend opens `SDL_AUDIO_DEVICE_DEFAULT_PLAYBACK`, so a change of the system default is whatever SDL3 does with a default-device stream; the ALSA backend does not reopen a PCM that disappears.
**EasyGL re-sends per-draw state the previous draw already set** (performance only; no picture is wrong).

**Custom-effect lookup and recovery limits** (`IEFFECT-AUDIT-001`, 2026-11-01): EasyGL's name setters still query GL on every call; mutable `GetProgram()` permits relinking without a detectable executable revision, so a handle/context-keyed cache would be unsafe.
**Three audio reports from the 2026-07-17 audit stay unconfirmed, not open:** high-pitched sound effects, missing audio files, and distorted or sped-up gameplay audio.

Three content-pipeline residues against genuine XNA output, none visible in the 7,726-reference sample sweep (`tools/xna-sample-sweep/README.md`, *What is left*): a generated `.x` normal can carry the opposite sign of a zero (13 of 1,291 probe normals, `XNASWEEP-231`); FBX bone transforms keep an ulp-level residue that grows with depth, inside the float tolerance (`XNASWEEP-228`..`232`); and `MeshHelper.OptimizeForCache`'s strip termination is empirical (9 of 20 probes exact, `XNASWEEP-149`)..

**Conformance programs on drivers and capability boundaries** (`*_Conformance_*`, `modules/graphics/examples/conformance/`, measured 2026-10-15/17): - `render_target_own_msaa` D (2x) failed on EasyGL in 2026-10-17's run and on SDLGPU and FNA3D once B2-04 gave multisampled targets XNA's integer pixel centres: its edge sat at the half-integer centre, beyond both 2x samples.

**LeakSanitizer reports leaks in the pinned SDL** (measured 2026-10-22/23 during the museum repairs): about 50 KB in about 910 allocations from initialization to destruction with no CNA code linked (lavapipe and RADV), so an SDLGPU sanitizer run does not end at exit 0 under LeakSanitizer; CNA suppresses none of it.

**`DIRECTX9` under Wine with DXVK 2.6.0: `DirectX9_CompiledEffects` hangs or aborts in DXVK's device teardown; DXVK 3.1.1 does not** (measured 2026-10-17, `cmake-build-mingw`, Release, `CNA_DIRECTX9_COMPILED_EFFECTS=ON`).
